authorization: User approved direct implementation and merge of ten selectable themes, first default.

assets.prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION BACKGROUND asset for a 2D card game, full-bleed landscape 16:10. Reference is a concept screenshot; extract and redesign ONLY the EMPTY ENVIRONMENT in the same tactile woodcut / blockprint + fine micro-pixel style. Absolutely NO table, NO chairs, NO characters or people or creatures, NO robots, NO dragon, NO cards, NO text, NO UI, NO labels, NO icons, NO status bars, NO logo, NO frames around the image. The game adds these separately.
Composition must leave a large unoccupied stage: simple room back wall / architecture in the upper 38%, horizon at about y38%, a broad quiet unobstructed floor spreading across the lower 62%. Decorative objects stay at the far left/right edges or above y35%, never in the middle/lower gameplay area. Frontal view from a slightly elevated near-side tabletop camera, straight verticals. A center scene that is calm and dark enough for gameplay silhouettes. Fine engraved paper grain, broad limited-color ink blocks, crisp slightly pixel-stepped contours; atmospheric but not densely rendered. No cinematic photorealism, no soft 3D render, no blurry painting. Consistent visual vocabulary with the approved ivory woodcut game cards. Keep light sources restrained and readable, avoid bright center spots.
SCENE: Warm chestnut timber beams, amber lanterns, a small cozy brick hearth on the back wall, a few silhouettes of shelves and potted plants. Colors burnt umber, copper, muted moss, amber. Broad plain warm dark wooden floor.
